name: io.github.antonio-castellon/mcp-glp-audit-proxy
title: GLP Audit Proxy
description: Local MCP proxy with a tamper-evident audit trail for GLP traceability.

environmentVariables.name: GLP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the proxy JSON config (upstreams, policy, audit file).

environmentVariables.name: GLP_PRINCIPAL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Authenticated human id for this process. Stdio identity comes from the environment.

environmentVariables.name: GLP_PRINCIPAL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Printed name of the human principal.

environmentVariables.name: GLP_PRINCIPAL_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: One of operator, approver, qa, admin.
